Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Dark Sovereigns is the first V:TES expansion. It will focus on Western
Europe. Yes, it will have V:TES card backs. While we have bounced around
the idea of printing some of the cards with Jyhad backs, the plan is currently
not to do so; it's probably better to just make a clean break.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
aa...@cats.ucsc.edu Wizards of the Coast, Inc.
